title: 4_4_Prom

quiz.question: What does the word 'abhor' mean?
options: To fall asleep because something is super boring.

quiz.question: What does the word 'elicit' mean?
options: A beast with an elephant head on a smaller elephant's body.

quiz.question: If an object travels at 3 feet per second, how many feet does it travel in one hour?
quiz.question_short: 3 feet per second. How many feet in an hour?
options: Trick question! Objects don't have 3 feet! Burned!

quiz.question: Which of the following is a factor of the sum of 15 + 45?
quiz.question_short: A factor of the sum of 15 + 45?

quiz.question: Which of the following is NOT a multiple of the sum of 9 + 3?
quiz.question_short: NOT a multiple of the sum of 9 + 3?
options: Me! I am not a multiple of 9 + 3!

quiz.question: If n + 1 = 25, what is the value of 3n + 3?
A number is divided by 4. The result is divided by 4, which equals 2. What was the original number?
quiz.question_short: Number divided by 4. Result divided by 4 to get 2. Original number?
options: I'm too smart to answer such easy questions.

quiz.question: What does the word 'fathom' mean?
options: To get a question wrong in a quiz.

quiz.question: What does the word 'gratuitous' mean?
options: Spitting everywhere like a camel. In short, not cool.

quiz.question: What does the word 'hackneyed' mean?
options: We couldn't think of anything for this... Wink. Wink.

quiz.question: What does the word 'iconoclast' mean?
options: One who can transform into a robot.
One who is really good with a computer.

How do you feel about the announcement of the end of SHS?
Are you excited for the final episode?

nodes.text: Just then, the lights dim, and a spotlight swivels to light the stage...
...Life just got really weird.
Now let's go back and see what happens when Owen doesn't reveal an underground superhero universe!
But before doing that... Be sure to check out The Super New Girl series when you get a chance! It's awesome!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, I have! I've been reading a lot of Hemingway. He's great.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh really? What do you like about him?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He doesn't waste my time. He tells real stories without a lot of fancy words.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: He does manage to be refreshingly economical amidst an ocean of needlessly verbose writers.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My point exactly.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So, have you cleaned out the local bookstores of Hemingway novels?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just about. But there's something else I like about spending time at the bookstore.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, really? What's that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: They remind me of you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Aww, Spencer... I suppose I have made my name synonymous with bookstores.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Come to think of it, I'm alarmingly well-acquainted with all the local booksellers...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, they all have a framed picture of you over the checkout counter... 'Most Valuable Customer.'

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: They do not!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Do they?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nah, just kidding. But they should.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Agreed. They definitely claim the lion's share of my monthly allowance...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? How can you say that?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't know! I thought maybe you were... I mean, it was a good idea for a date!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It was a good idea for a date with `you.` Candace isn't really a huge fan of books.
nodes.text_bbcode: It was a good idea for a date with [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color] Candace isn't really a huge fan of books.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes, I suppose she wouldn't have been as impressed as I was. I'm sorry, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't worry about it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So, why did you take Candace to bookstores so often, knowing she didn't like books that much?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know, I guess I was just...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Just what?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nothing, forget it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I have been thinking about us a lot lately, about our past...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes. I've come to the conclusion that I should have gone with you to Homecoming...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Instead of Cameron. That was `definitely` a mistake.
nodes.text_bbcode: Instead of Cameron. That was [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] a mistake.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, my mistake. I shouldn't have taken so long to ask you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You were going to ask me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah... I was stalling like an idiot, and as soon as I got up the nerve to ask you, Kimi told me that Cameron beat me to it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Aw, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I just... I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I just wish I'd gone with you instead.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, well. Anyway, I wanted to ask you something...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I heard you've been going to a lot of bookstores recently.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Really? Where'd you hear that?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Candace told me, when we were all at the movie theater together.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, right. Yeah, we went to a few.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We actually went to the one where we had our bookstore dinner date, remember?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes, I certainly do. Have you been...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, sure!
Spencer moves in close to $ALLISON, his hands grabbing her hips.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Whoa! I didn't mean slow-dancing with me!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What'd you mean then?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Dancing with everyone!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sorry! How was I supposed to know?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You and Candace just broke up, and I'm here with Nate! Isn't it obvious?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry... Why don't we just, uh, talk or something?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm sorry, too... For my lack of clarity...
$ALLISON and Spencer stand silently and awkwardly next to each other for a minute. Then...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Talk? Yeah... I can... Talk.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I have every confidence that you can.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh. It's been a while since I felt like an idiot trying to talk.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's what I'm here for.
A small, peaceful moment passes between them, then...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Well, it's not like we `have` to be together.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it's not like we [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to be together.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But... I like hanging out with you...

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Same here, same here. Hey... Why don't we just take a time out for a little while?

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Then, maybe we can go back to being friends. Deal?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Deal.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: All right. See you around, man.
Candace gives Spencer a friendly punch in the arm and walks back out into the gym.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ouch.
$ALLISON sees Spencer reenter the gym, his face fallen.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Nate, would you mind if I go check on Spencer? He looks somewhat dejected.
Nate looks across the gym to where Spencer is leaning against a wall, looking down at his shoes.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, it's no problem. Go for it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Thank you, Nate. It means a lot.
$ALLISON makes her way over to Spencer and leans on the wall next to him.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hey, Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, Red. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I saw Candace come out of the weight room without you. Is everything okay?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, everything's fine. Candace and I are done, though.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Did you have an altercation?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, something like that... We just aren't going to go out anymore or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't worry about it. How are you and Nate?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, we're doing well, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He doesn't care that you're, you know, talking to me?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Actually, no. I thought he would be annoyed, but he knows that you're... You know.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That I'm what?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Important to me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wow, uh... You're important to me, too. And that's... Pretty cool of Nate.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes, it is. I know he used to be somewhat morally destitute, but he's changed a lot.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey. You don't have to explain it to me. If you're happy, I'm happy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And I guess I see what you mean about Nate. He's not as bad as he used to be.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Thank you, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No problem. Thanks for checking in with me, by the way.
Spencer pushes off the wall and starts heading toward the exit.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Are you going somewhere?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, I think I might head out. I don't have much left to do here, now that Candace and I are... Over.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, why don't you...

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: I rarely am.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Although right about now I wish I was.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Are you serious? I see how you look at her.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: When do I look at her?

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Whenever she's around!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I was just looking at Nate!

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Do you need his permission to dance with me or something?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! He was just... Giving me a thumbs-up! Like, 'Nice dancing, Spence!'

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't believe that.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't believe it either...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm really sorry...

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: You can't help how you feel...
Nate leads Paige and Owen to a corner of the gym where $ALLISON and some of the Troublemakers are hanging out.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Owen! Paige! You made it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, all thanks to Nate!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And Owen's driving!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Huh-ho! Look at you two foxes! I feel handsomer just looking at you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks, buddy. Uh, you too.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ohmygosh, Delilah you look incredible!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Aw, thanks, Paige!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is Kimi around?
Just then, Kimi pushes through a crowd of people to join the group! Logan lags behind her.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Owen, Paige, we've been looking all over for you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Kimi! We only just got here.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm surprised you're not with the musicians, Logan.
$ALLISON gestures to the makeshift stage where a band is rocking out.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: This dance thing isn't really my scene. I'll be back in a sec, Kimi, I'm gonna grab some punch.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh... okay.
Logan slouches off toward the punch table.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What was that about?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't know. He's been acting... Bored, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, he should at least make an effort, seeing as `he` asked `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, he should at least make an effort, seeing as [color=#3b78e2][i]he[/i][/color] asked [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I know, but really I'm just glad I have a date, especially after the Winter Dance...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't sell yourself short just because of Brinna's stupid prank.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Especially now that she's been knocked down a peg! I heard your elaborate revenge plot was a resounding success, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, it was pretty awesome. Next time you need revenge on someone, talk to Paige. She's a master schemer.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Speaking of scheming, have they announced the King and Queen?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Not yet, but I've been campaigning for you all night. I think I've enlisted most of the student body.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks, $ALLISON! I'll remember your loyalty when I rule this prom.
Kevin walks up to Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Sorry to interrupt, but I was wondering... Kimi, would you like to dance?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, Kevin... I'm sort of... Here with somebody, you know?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Oh, yeah... Logan, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, Kimi, you can spare one dance! Logan's `getting punch,` remember?
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, Kimi, you can spare one dance! Logan's [color=#3b78e2][i]getting punch,[/i][/color] remember?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: All right, one dance!
You are now playing as Kimi.
Kevin leads Kimi out onto the dance floor and puts his arms around her waist.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm surprised you're here, Kevin. Don't you have some creeps to deny or lanes to guard or whatever?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I do, but they can wait. All things in moderation... Including video games.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Especially` video games. In your case, at least.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Especially[/i][/color] video games. In your case, at least.

nodes.text: Kimi leans in to Kevin and puts her head on his shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: So... You and Logan, huh?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ugh, maybe. He's been kind of flaky tonight.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Well, you're probably used to that, right? After me, I mean.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Did you just burn yourself?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I didn't want you to suddenly think I was perfect.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: In all seriousness, I wish that when we were together, I'd been... Better.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I think I just didn't know what was important at the time.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hindsight's 20/20.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I know, believe me. Either way, you deserve better... And I hope you find someone who can see that.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks, Kevin.
You are now playing as Spencer.
As the rest of the Troublemakers join Kimi and Kevin on the dance floor, Candace leads Spencer out, giving him instructions.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Now I put my arms around your neck... Sort of like an inverted nelson.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! As if I couldn't hammerlock suplex before you got a full nelson!

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Care to test that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? Here?

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Hmph. Wrestling probably isn't permitted at prom.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: But that's okay... I don't feel like wrestling right now.
Candace nestles in closer to Spencer, but his attention is across the dance floor, where $ALLISON and Nate are dancing together.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Okay! That's it! Come with me!
Candace grabs Spencer by the hand and leads him through a side door...
In the weight room, Candace pushes Spencer on to one of the weight benches and sits down at a machine across from him.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: I know you still like her, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Don't play dumb. $ALLISON, of course. Am I wrong?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The truth is...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, man, we really appreciate it.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: No problem! Anything for those I've never called a friend!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you're going to keep being nice, I might have to keep you in my contacts.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, where's $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Follow me!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on, Paige... Nate just did us a solid.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nate only does things for himself. What's your game, creep?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: My game? What's so sinister about `not` locking you out of the dance?
nodes.text_bbcode: My game? What's so sinister about [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] locking you out of the dance?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: He kind of has a point there.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, maybe I jumped the gun on that accusation. Thanks, Nate.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Let's just go find $ALLISON, she'll want to see you guys.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Lead the way.
Owen gives up... Slumping down while Bear looms over him in triumph!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: HAHAHA! I won the match! `I` won the scholarship!
nodes.text_bbcode: HAHAHA! I won the match! [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] won the scholarship!

nodes.text: But then, just as Owen's about to lose consciousness...
The lights overhead glow an intense white, finally bursting and showering the crowd with bits of glass!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hhhh...?
Owen feels himself rising, as if lifted by a powerful force!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Aaaaaanddddd... You're free!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What the!
Standing in front of Owen are a bunch of older Twin Branches students, dressed in superhero outfits.
All around him, time is frozen. Bear is still standing triumphantly, Grandma Betty is still clapping consolingly... And Paige, Paige is there...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This is too weird.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're the Centerscore Supers. A team dedicated to fighting crime and serving justice!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do you always have to sound so lame when you introduce us?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: More to the point...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, can we get to that? Today, please. Someone's super hungry.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're here to recruit you for our superhero team. Want to join?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't understand... I just... I just lost. Why would you want me after I failed?
A green eagle soars overhead, tumbles through the air, and lands at Owen's feet, morphing into Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He doesn't know! You really don't know?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?! What don't I know?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Your opponent, Bear, is a servant of Viktor von Dyre, the Dreadlord of Doomsday!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, who now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Amanda, could you show Owen what Bear really looks like?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Of course!
Amanda snaps her fingers, revealing Bear's true self! A hideous, snarling bear!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... This whole time... I've been wrestling a bear?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I think he gets it now!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're super, Owen. You have enormous strength. You just need to realize your potential.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You didn't win. But we're impressed with your skills. I guess.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Blah blah blah. In or out, Stripes?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whether or not to join your superhero team? Who says no to that?! I'm in!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! More people! More fun!
As the superheroes fly Owen out of the gym, he looks back and wonders about the new path of his life...
He wonders about Paige and Grandma Betty and Prom, but it only lasts for a moment...
Then he thinks about how awesome it is to be a superhero, and he knows that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `YAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen yanks Bear's arm off of him, simultaneously inhaling a burst of burning, euphoric oxygen and tripping Bear, slamming him onto the mat!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: Oof! Hey!
Owen scrambles on top of Bear, pinning him!
The referee raises Owen's hand over his head! The match is over! Owen won!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: What?! `NOOOOOOOO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! [color=#e23b3b][i]NOOOOOOOO![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I did it! I won the scholarship!
Owen gets mobbed by his teammates!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yeah, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: You won the match!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Just so you know, I had almost no faith in you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks again, Steve.
Seeing Grandma Betty and Paige, he runs over to the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh, Owie! You did it! I'm so proud of you!
He turns to Paige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You came.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course I came. Someone from a `real` school had to come to this dump.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course I came. Someone from a [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] school had to come to this dump.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But... Prom? This was your shot to win Prom Queen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's... It's no biggie...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know that face.
He looks at the gym clock...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: When do the doors close on Prom?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nine o'clock. That's in fifteen minutes, and we're thirty minutes away...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...It's okay, Owen, really...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I can catch a ride with one of these other handsome young gentlemen.
She hands Owen the key to her station wagon.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Just try not break it.
Owen grabs Paige by the hand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ew, sweaty.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Deal with it. We're going to Prom.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you planning on going in that?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My tux is in the car. It's going to be... An `interesting` car ride.
nodes.text_bbcode: My tux is in the car. It's going to be... An [color=#e23b3b][i]interesting[/i][/color] car ride.

nodes.text: Twelve minutes later...
Owen's pushing the station wagon to its max, hugging every corner with pinpoint precision...
Meanwhile...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Stop turning so much! I can't pin this boutonniere on without pricking you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just do it! Anything's better than the shave you just tried to give me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like it was my fault that your face is so curvy! Or that you braked so suddenly!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There was a kid in the middle of the street!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just consider it a miracle that we even got you dressed!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm still not sure how you did that... You closed your eyes, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uhhh... Hey! Look at that! Your boutonniere is on!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And not a moment too soon!
You are now playing as Paige.
The tires on the wagon squeal as Owen slides the car seamlessly into a parking spot.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Time?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nine exactly!
Owen and Paige get out of the car and hurry to the gymnasium doors, but they're locked!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're too late! I'm so sorry, Paige...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sheesh. For someone who never gives up during wrestling, you quit pretty easy on life.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Right... Maybe we can get ahold of someone?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A step ahead of you. I just sent a mass text to my contacts.
A few minutes pass without any reply.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Still no response?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't know what's taking them so long.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe they can't hear their phones over the music?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, hopefully one of them was smart enough to set their phone to vibrate.
Just then, the door opens! But the person behind it is...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Paige! Owen! Nice of you to join us!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Nate?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Nate?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How'd you know we were out here?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Text from Paige. Surprised you had my number.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You know you're a little late, right? Doors close at nine.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, well...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `YAAAAAAAAH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YAAAAAAAAH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen begins to pull on Bear's massive forearm, prying it off of his throat!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grrr!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: Hey! What are you doing?!
Every part of his body screams for him to yield.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Gfff... What's the point without... Paige?
He feels the strength leaving his body...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hnnnggg...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Bear is the best wrestler in the state!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Plus, his name is Bear, which I find alarming.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: But don't be nervous, man! If you lose, no worries, right? I mean you'll still have Paige!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... And no scholarship... I'll only get it if I win this match.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Scholarship?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah! The `reason` I'm wearing a Wilson High singlet right now! Where have you been?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! The [color=#e23b3b][i]reason[/i][/color] I'm wearing a Wilson High singlet right now! Where have you been?!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I don't know, man! Everything's happening so fast! When did I even become relevant?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, I `have` to win.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, I [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] to win.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Well, dude, you can totally beat this guy...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know if I can. It's Twin Branches's Prom Night tonight.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Major scheduling fiasco, bro. But, also, why does that matter?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It means Paige is at Prom, trying to rally votes for Prom Queen. I should be there for her, and I can't stop thinking about it.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Not trying to ruffle any feathers, but isn't this more important?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: But shouldn't `she` be here for `you?`
nodes.text_bbcode: But shouldn't [color=#e23b3b][i]she[/i][/color] be here for [color=#e23b3b][i]you?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's complicated, okay?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Sure, man. You got enough on your brain.
A bell rings, signifying the call to the mat.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This is it...
A moment later, Owen steps out onto the mat in the middle of the gym and, with a glimmer of hope, scans the crowd for Paige, his gaze finally settling on--

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: --Oh! That's my Owie! Over here, dear!
Owen waves, noticing the empty seat next to her, the spot where Paige normally sits...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Grandma...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Hi, Owie! Wipe the floor with him, will you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, sure.
Grandma Betty nudges her neighbor with an elbow...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: That's my grandson. He doesn't go to this awful school, but he is bringing respectability to it.
Some of the Wilson High wrestlers clap for Owen.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You got this, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I don't know about that, Skazz... Have you seen Bear?
Steve nods toward Owen's opponent, and Owen's eyes immediately widen! Looming in front of him is Bear, the biggest guy he's ever seen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa! Even his fingers look muscular!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: I'm gonna crush you like the stick that you are, Stick!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: He called you 'Stick', Owen. He's implying you're really breakable, like a stick. It's a metaphor.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks. I got it, Steve.
Owen gets into position...
`In Owen's mind...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]In Owen's mind...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You make me feel... More like me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine! `I'll` shut you up!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! [color=#3b78e2][i]I'll[/i][/color] shut you up!

nodes.text: Paige pulls Owen close!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige, I love--
--They kiss! And as they kiss, Paige melts into Owen's arms, trembling.
At long last, they part.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did... Did you just say that you love me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I said, 'I love--' and then you cut me off.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was going to say, 'I love the ocean.'

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I love the ocean!
Owen gets picked up, jolting him into the present!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oof!
His body gets smacked down hard into the mat, followed immediately by the crushing force of Bear's body!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: Wait... What'd you say about the ocean?!
Bear is surprised enough to give Owen space to wiggle free!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Yay! Owie!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Oh, wow. I didn't think you had a chance, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: Grrr!
Before Owen can react, Bear pulls him into a crushing, unbreakable hold!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: You're mine now, Ocean Lover!
As his breath is squeezed out of him, Owen feels himself getting light-headed, losing consciousness...
He has no choice but to...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sometimes when I focus I, uh, do that with my lips.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: That's weird.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, but nothing sharpens me more!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Well good then, keep those lips puckered 'cause you're going to need maximum focus to beat this guy.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Are you going to kiss him or something?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? Oh, no... Uh... I was just imagining a controversial wrestling move.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Sure you were. I know you were actually thinking about that hot girlfriend of yours!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe I was...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You've got to focus on the match, man!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: You are now playing as Paige.
Owen steps closer to her and leans down for one sweet, tender, perfect--
--But a spotlight suddenly shines on Paige!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Huh? What's going on?!

nodes.speaker: DJ
nodes.text: Uh, Paige? You won.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I won?!

nodes.speaker: DJ
nodes.text: You won! You're the Prom Queen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ha ha! I won!
Paige leaves Owen and bounds up the steps to the stage, where she receives her crown.

nodes.speaker: DJ
nodes.text: Anything to say now that you've won?
The DJ hands the mic to Paige...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes! I just want to say...
She looks down at Owen...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...That I can't accept the crown...
A wave of shock rolls over the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I never thought I'd hear that!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Paige `has` to be the Queen!
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige [color=#3b78e2][i]has[/i][/color] to be the Queen!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My asthma!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I actually have a confession to make...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A while back, I got into a fight with Maria. She was planning on making my life miserable.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I swore to get her before she got me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: My plan was to destroy the cheerleading team, sink her popularity, and gain enough favor to win the crown she wanted so desperately...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...And that's exactly what I did.
Another wave of shock rolls through the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Whoa! Drama.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ha! Awesome! This is better than TV!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm hyper ventilating! I feel like I'm in space! I'm hyperspace ventilating!
The DJ tries to take the mic back...

nodes.speaker: DJ
nodes.text: Ha ha! She's joking! What a funny and uncomfortable joke!
...But Paige wrestles it away from him.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The reason I'm confessing this now is because I don't want this crown anymore...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't want to `get` Maria. It seems so petty now.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't want to [color=#3b78e2][i]get[/i][/color] Maria. It seems so petty now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All I want is to enjoy the last days of high school with the one I care about most.
The crowd collectively makes an 'aww' sound.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: To prove it, I'm giving up my crown. Maria, you deserve this.
Paige steps down from the stage and hands her crown over to Maria.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're serious?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. And I'll even help you rebuild the squad.

nodes.speaker: DJ
nodes.text: Okay! Let's hear it for our `new` Prom Queen... Maria!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay! Let's hear it for our [color=#e23b3b][i]new[/i][/color] Prom Queen... Maria!

nodes.text: As the crowd cheers, Paige climbs down from the stage and into Owen's arms.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I love you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know you do.
Owen kisses her, and even though Paige has given up what she once held dear, everything feels `right.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen kisses her, and even though Paige has given up what she once held dear, everything feels [b]right.[/b]

nodes.speaker: DJ
nodes.text: And of course that means, Maria will get to dance with the Prom King...
The DJ looks askance at the sheet of paper he's holding.

nodes.speaker: DJ
nodes.text: Uh... Chris?

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Woohoo!
Chris runs up onstage, grabs the crown, and stands near Maria.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Your name is Chris?

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Always has been. But you'll remember it more after our dance.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oh yeah, why's that?

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Because nobody dances better than me!
Chris snaps his fingers, and a beat thumps.
He taps his foot to the beat, swaying his head from side-to-side.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: You ready for this?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I don't think I am...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: It'll be fun!
With a flourish, he takes Maria's hand and begins dancing an impromptu tango!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Chris! Where did you learn to dance like this?!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Do you like it?

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Never mind. I know you do.
He dips her.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Like it? I love it!
You are now playing as Kimi...
After Maria and Chris's dance, the music's tempo slows...

nodes.speaker: DJ
nodes.text: All right, everybody! It's time for the last dance of the night, so grab that special someone and make this Prom a night to remember...
As couples begin to pair off, Kimi looks desperately around for Logan...
She scans the dance floor...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Where is he?!
Behind the stage...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I finally snag a hot guy, and he's not even with me!
Kimi returns to the dance floor...
...And that's when she sees Logan in the corner, making out with Nicole!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: How... How could he?!
Kimi storms over to Logan!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing?!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Hey, why don't you leave me alone?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe because you're my date and two seconds ago you had your tongue down her throat!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ew! Kissing me is `not` that gross.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ew! Kissing me is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] that gross.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Seriously, you're cramping my style.
Logan goes back to kissing Nicole.
Nearby, Kevin sees what's going on.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Grrr...
Brinna sidles up to Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Did what I think just happened `actually` happen? Gosh, Pig Girl, you must feel soooooooo `bad!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did what I think just happened [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] happen? Gosh, Pig Girl, you must feel soooooooo [color=#3b78e2][i]bad![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Brinna calls out to everyone!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Hey! Check it out, everyone! Pig Girl just got dumped!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Didn't I already crush you?

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Revenge is sweet. You should know.
A small crowd of chuckling students start to form around Kimi and Brinna...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Why is this always happening to me?!
And then...
Kevin storms over!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hey, Logan! You owe her an apology.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: I don't owe her anything.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah, you do.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: What are you gonna do about it, dork?
Logan stands up and shoves Kevin back.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: This.
Kevin grabs Logan by the collar and throws a perfect punch!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Oof!
Logan goes flying backward...
...And crashes into the punch table! The punch bowl sails through the air, landing on Brinna and showering her with deep-red, ice-cold punch!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Hnnnngg...
The crowd that had been chuckling at Kimi erupts into laughter, pointing at Brinna!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Kevin! You... You just knocked out Logan!
Kevin holds up his fist.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I did... That's the first time I've punched anyone...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: It looks so much less painful in video games...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Here!
Kimi scoops some ice from the punch and wraps it in a napkin.
Just then, Ms. Lee forces her way through the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You're in very big trouble, young man!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yes, Ms. Lee...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: At least, that's what I'm supposed to say.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, I did see the `whole` thing. And frankly, my nephew probably deserved that punch.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I did see the [color=#3b78e2][i]whole[/i][/color] thing. And frankly, my nephew probably deserved that punch.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Come to think of it, he probably deserved many of the punches he's gotten...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Huh, I'm suddenly questioning my judgment... Could I be... Delusional?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Ha! Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I'll have to punish you in `some` way...
nodes.text_bbcode: Unfortunately, I'll have to punish you in [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] way...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Maybe I could join this Troublemakers group I've been hearing so much about...
Kevin shoots Kimi a wink.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: A fine idea. Now if you'll excuse me, I have to tend to family...
Ms. Lee leaves.
Kimi tends to Kevin's swollen fist.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I didn't think anyone would `ever` do something like that for me!
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't think anyone would [color=#3b78e2][i]ever[/i][/color] do something like that for me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I mean, you kind of always dream that a guy will fight for you...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...But it's always like a metaphorical fight, you know? Not an actual fight!
She looks up at him and gives him a peck on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks, Kevin.
Before she can pull back, Kevin pulls her in and kisses her!
...And as the last song plays, they hold each other, swaying to the music while their kiss persists in a final, magical moment.
At last, they part...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Is this the start of something?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I think it's the end, actually.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The end of what?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I don't know... But ask me at graduation...
You have reached the end of `Season 4, Episode 4: Prom!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 4, Episode 4: Prom![/b]

nodes.text: Want to catch up?! Check out `Troublemakers 1: Origins`, `Troublemakers 2: Holiday Hearts!`, and `Troublemakers 3: Secrets Exposed!` All in More Episodes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Want to catch up?! Check out [b]Troublemakers 1: Origins[/b], [b]Troublemakers 2: Holiday Hearts![/b], and [b]Troublemakers 3: Secrets Exposed![/b] All in More Episodes!

nodes.text: And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige? You okay?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I just... I'm just trying not to cry, okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Cry? Did I say something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! You said everything `right!` It's just... No one's ever meant what you mean to me...
nodes.text_bbcode: No! You said everything [color=#3b78e2][i]right![/i][/color] It's just... No one's ever meant what you mean to me...

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's a good thing, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's just... It's a `very` good thing.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's just... It's a [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] good thing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Hate` to love?! What's wrong with loving me?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Hate[/i][/color] to love?! What's wrong with loving me?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... The constant verbal attacks. Yeah, the constant verbal attacks.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: When have I `ever` said anything bad to you?
nodes.text_bbcode: When have I [color=#3b78e2][i]ever[/i][/color] said anything bad to you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you talking about today? Or the last hour?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, shut up. The big point here is that you love me. You're crazy for me.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Crazy... That's `exactly` the word I'd use to describe how I feel around you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Crazy... That's [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] the word I'd use to describe how I feel around you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you going to keep messing around or are you going to kiss me?
You are now playing as Owen.

nodes.speaker: DJ
nodes.text: Hey now, everybody! It's time for the `biiiiiiiiig` announcement! Who will be this year's Prom King and Queen!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey now, everybody! It's time for the [color=#e23b3b][i]biiiiiiiiig[/i][/color] announcement! Who will be this year's Prom King and Queen!

nodes.text: Everyone gathers around the stage...
Paige tugs on Owen's arm.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is it going to be me? Do you think it's going to be me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It had `better` be me.
nodes.text_bbcode: It had [color=#3b78e2][i]better[/i][/color] be me.

nodes.text: He pulls her aside.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What is it? They're going to announce, like, `right` now!
nodes.text_bbcode: What is it? They're going to announce, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]right[/i][/color] now!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, I know. Just listen...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: In your campaign for Prom Queen, you did some shady things...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, Lieutenant Intercom, not everyone knows about that!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry, but... I just wanted to say that even though you did that... I actually feel like you've grown.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I have?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure. Instead of insulting me about being poor, now you just insult me. That's progress.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I thought you were being serious...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I `am` being serious. When I was wrestling today, I kept thinking about you...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] being serious. When I was wrestling today, I kept thinking about you...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: About us... About our memories together...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The Paige I kissed during that Psych project is `not` the Paige I'm standing beside right now.
nodes.text_bbcode: The Paige I kissed during that Psych project is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] the Paige I'm standing beside right now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I like what you're saying. I'm not sure why you're saying it, but I like it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What I'm saying is... Crown or no crown, popular or not popular, you're always going to be...

options.label: The girl I hate to love!

nodes.text: But something in Owen resists!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No!
And then--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen! You can do it, Owen! I'm here for you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hmmf... Paige? Can't be...

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: Go to sleep, Baby! Go to sleep!
Bear twists Owen around, increasing the pressure, but also rotating Owen so that he's facing the spot where Grandma Betty's sitting and...
...The spot where Paige is now! She's wearing a sleek red dress, her hair falling in curls down her shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige? So pretty...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, Owen! Beat this guy!
You are now playing as Paige.
The tires on the wagon squeal as Owen slides the car seamlessly into a parking spot.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Time?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nine exactly!
Owen and Paige get out of the car and hurry to the gymnasium doors, but they're locked!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're too late! I'm so sorry, Paige...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sheesh. For someone who never gives up during wrestling, you quit pretty easy on life.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Right... Maybe we can get ahold of someone?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A step ahead of you. I just sent a mass text to my contacts.
A few minutes pass without any reply.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Still no response?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't know what's taking them so long.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe they can't hear their phones over the music?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, hopefully one of them was smart enough to set their phone to vibrate.
Just then, the door opens! But the person behind it is...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Paige! Owen! Nice of you to join us!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Nate?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Nate?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How'd you know we were out here?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Text from Paige. Surprised you had my number.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You know you're a little late, right? Doors close at nine.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, well...
Twelve minutes later...
Owen's pushing the station wagon to its max, hugging every corner with pinpoint precision...
Meanwhile...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Stop turning so much! I can't pin this boutonniere on without pricking you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just do it! Anything's better than the shave you just tried to give me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like it was my fault that your face is so curvy! Or that you braked so suddenly!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There was a kid in the middle of the street!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just consider it a miracle that we even got you dressed!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm still not sure how you did that... You closed your eyes, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uhhh... Hey! Look at that! Your boutonniere is on!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And not a moment too soon!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `YAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen yanks Bear's arm off of him, simultaneously inhaling a burst of burning, euphoric oxygen and tripping Bear, slamming him onto the mat!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: Oof! Hey!
Owen scrambles on top of Bear, pinning him!
The referee raises Owen's hand over his head! The match is over! Owen won!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: What?! `NOOOOOOOO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! [color=#e23b3b][i]NOOOOOOOO![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I did it! I won the scholarship!
Owen gets mobbed by his teammates!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yeah, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: You won the match!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Just so you know, I had almost no faith in you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks again, Steve.
Seeing Grandma Betty and Paige, he runs over to the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh, Owie! You did it! I'm so proud of you!
He turns to Paige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You came.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course I came. Someone from a `real` school had to come to this dump.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course I came. Someone from a [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] school had to come to this dump.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But... Prom? This was your shot to win Prom Queen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's... It's no biggie...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know that face.
He looks at the gym clock...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: When do the doors close on Prom?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nine o'clock. That's in fifteen minutes, and we're thirty minutes away...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...It's okay, Owen, really...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I can catch a ride with one of these other handsome young gentlemen.
She hands Owen the key to her station wagon.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Just try not break it.
Owen grabs Paige by the hand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ew, sweaty.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Deal with it. We're going to Prom.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you planning on going in that?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My tux is in the car. It's going to be... An `interesting` car ride.
nodes.text_bbcode: My tux is in the car. It's going to be... An [color=#e23b3b][i]interesting[/i][/color] car ride.

nodes.text: Before Owen can react, Bear pulls him into a crushing, unbreakable hold!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: You're mine now, Ocean Lover!
As his breath is squeezed out of him, Owen feels himself getting light-headed, losing consciousness...
He has no choice but to...
You are now playing as Owen.

nodes.speaker: DJ
nodes.text: Hey now, everybody! It's time for the `biiiiiiiiig` announcement! Who will be this year's Prom King and Queen!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey now, everybody! It's time for the [color=#e23b3b][i]biiiiiiiiig[/i][/color] announcement! Who will be this year's Prom King and Queen!

nodes.text: Everyone gathers around the stage...
Paige tugs on Owen's arm.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is it going to be me? Do you think it's going to be me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It had `better` be me.
nodes.text_bbcode: It had [color=#3b78e2][i]better[/i][/color] be me.

nodes.text: He pulls her aside.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What is it? They're going to announce, like, `right` now!
nodes.text_bbcode: What is it? They're going to announce, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]right[/i][/color] now!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, I know. Just listen...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: In your campaign for Prom Queen, you did some shady things...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, Lieutenant Intercom, not everyone knows about that!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry, but... I just wanted to say that even though you did that... I actually feel like you've grown.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I have?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure. Instead of insulting me about being poor, now you just insult me. That's progress.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I thought you were being serious...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I `am` being serious. When I was wrestling today, I kept thinking about you...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] being serious. When I was wrestling today, I kept thinking about you...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: About us... About our memories together...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The Paige I kissed during that Psych project is `not` the Paige I'm standing beside right now.
nodes.text_bbcode: The Paige I kissed during that Psych project is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] the Paige I'm standing beside right now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I like what you're saying. I'm not sure why you're saying it, but I like it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What I'm saying is... Crown or no crown, popular or not popular, you're always going to be...

options.label: The girl I hate to love!

The night of prom, Chris sits in his parked car, punching a number into his phone.
Can't wait to share the good news!
Chris puts the phone up to his ear. It rings... and someone picks up.
Hector the Party Selector, you have the right to party!
Hector, this is Chris, from Twin Branches!
No way! How's it going, little dude? You're still keeping the party going at Twin Branches, right?
You know it! That's why I'm calling, actually. My buddy and I are throwing a party after graduation, and I'd be honored if you were there.
Sure thing, man! I'd love to see my apprentice at work. And you know what?
I can think of `a lot` of old friends who'd be down! Is it cool with you if I invite them?
`Correct!` That was a test, young one. And you have `passed.` Stay on the line, I'll set up a conference call...
Chris stares in bewilderment at his phone's display as Hector adds more and more people to the call!
Denni? Man, I haven't heard from you guys in ages!
Room for one more on this call?
All right, quiet down, everyone. Plenty of time to catch up later. I'm sure you're all wondering...
Why did Hector add us all to this conference call? Especially this late at night?
In that case, I have a question for `all of you.`
Do any of you remember... Chris?
I think he might've been before my time.
Come on, guys! My party apprentice? The man of the hour?
Looks a bit like a clown?
Exactly! Anyway, he's on the line, and he has something to ask all of you... Go ahead, Chris.
Um... Hello, legends of Centerscore... I'm throwing a big party after graduation. Would any of you be... Um... Interested in attending?
I'm there! Thanks for the invite, Chris!
Yeah, I don't know you, but I'm in. See you then.
All right! Congratulations, Chris. This party is officially going to be `insane.` Maybe even better than all of my best parties `combined.` Maybe even... The best party `ever.`
Hector ends the conference call, and Chris stares at his phone's blank screen.
The girl in the passenger seat puts her hand in his.
Wow... Sounds like this is going to be a pretty big party, huh?

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise.
